description: This file defines a Java interface named UserProfile, which specifies methods related to user profile management within the RomRaider ECU logging application. The interface includes methods for checking logger data inclusion, selection status on various UI tabs, obtaining data convertors, and retrieving protocol information.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: A Java interface for user profile operations within the ECU logging application, defining methods for profile data interaction.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the logger data is included in the user profile.

methods.name: isSelectedOnLiveDataTab
methods.description: Determines if the logger data is selected on the live data tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnGraphTab
methods.description: Determines if the logger data is selected on the graph tab.

methods.name: isSelectedOnDashTab
methods.description: Determines if the logger data is selected on the dash tab.

methods.name: getSelectedConvertor
methods.description: Retrieves the data convertor associated with the logger data.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns a byte array representation of the user profile.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol string used by the user profile.
